segments.visible_description: Comic emphasis card reading ‘These are the women who check the whole machine.’
segments.narration: Last week you learned to check the machine. These are the women who check the whole machine.
segments.editorial_purpose: Land the exact comparison before the LUMINAiRY reveal begins.

segments.visible_description: The dark MAiVENS portrait hall illuminates progressively around the heroine.
segments.narration: And then the lights come up, and it’s just me, in the back of the LUMINAiRY, holding all of it.
segments.editorial_purpose: Compress the admitted lights-up arc into the line that explicitly says the lights come up instead of stretching it across unrelated narration.

segments.visible_description: The heroine stands in the dark MAiVENS hall with a glowing chatbot open on her laptop, surrounded by portraits of women.
segments.narration: Almost two hundred years. A room full of women who fought to be believed, one confident chatbot, and what has been sitting in your browser tab.
segments.editorial_purpose: Put the lineage, heroine and browser/chatbot evidence in one narration-specific composition.

segments.visible_description: Comic emphasis card reading ‘Not magic. Not born last Tuesday!’
segments.narration: Not magic. Not born last Tuesday.
segments.editorial_purpose: Give the punch line its exact, short visual beat.

segments.visible_description: Comic map card identifying agentic AI as the edge of the map.
segments.narration: The newest chapter is agentic AI: it does not just answer; it goes and does the thing. That is the edge of the map right now.
segments.editorial_purpose: Change the visual exactly when the narration moves from historical lineage to the current frontier.

segments.visible_description: Three women talk over drinks in a lived-in happy-hour setting.
segments.narration: So—the cocktail-party version, for when someone at happy hour asks whether AI is brand new.
segments.editorial_purpose: Establish the real-life social use case before showing the concise answer.

segments.visible_description: Comic cocktail card reading ‘Almost 200 years old and about three years old at the same time.’
segments.narration: It is almost two hundred years old and about three years old at the same time.
segments.editorial_purpose: Reserve the exact-answer card for the exact answer rather than forcing it to carry the whole closing.

segments.visible_description: Women discuss AI together at a cocktail table, connecting its long scientific lineage to present-day access.
segments.narration: The science has been building for centuries; your access is new. Every real leap—the idea, signal, language, finding and sight—has a woman’s name on it.
segments.editorial_purpose: Return from the one-line answer to the women and shared conversation behind it.

segments.visible_description: The heroine climbs the illuminated LUMINAiRY steps with her backpack for the episode’s field trip.
segments.narration: Whether or not the textbook wrote it down, that is the episode. This week is a field trip; everything you need lives at laidies.ai.
segments.editorial_purpose: Make the no-Try-On field trip and LAiDIES destination visually literal without introducing a false task.

segments.visible_description: The heroine enters a bright MAiVENS wing filled with many more women’s portraits.
segments.narration: The written story has every name and date to check. Only a handful of MAiVENS fit in the episode; the wing is full, and the assignment is to meet another.
segments.editorial_purpose: End p51 inside the full wing the narration names and hand the assignment cleanly into p52.

editorial_boundary: The former 124-second two-source hold is replaced by ten narration-matched beats; the existing lights-up arc is used only while the lights-up line is spoken.
